marta-devex: heads-up — ran into a weird onboarding break with samplekit and TS helper types + jsonMode on retries.

ishaan-sdk: ugh, quick summary?

marta-devex: gist: we construct SDK with jsonMode:true and strictSchema:true. first attempt rejects extra props (good). auth 401 triggers retry and the helper instance returned on retry has loose typing/coercion — TypeScript helper ends up returning a union of string|object and the consumer types blow up. snippet:```ts
const client = new RedwoodSDK({ jsonMode: true, strictSchema: true, helperFactory: makeTypedHelper });
await client.callTool('resolveAccount', payload); // on 401 retry: helper = makeTypedHelper() // factory falls back to permissive types if it reads env or global defaults
```

claire-qa: saw a flakey e2e yesterday where TS consumers threw at runtime because the fncall payload was stringified. Repro: run onboarding with simulated 401 then assert the final returned type is still the validated object shape.

ishaan-sdk: sounds like two coupled issues: 1) retry re-instantiates helper from factory that may read env/global defaults 2) our TypeScript helper exposes a loose public signature when created without explicit opts. Quick mitigation: make RetryWrapper capture the exact helper instance/options from the first attempt and reuse them for retries (or shallow-clone opts into retry). That will preserve runtime behavior and types for callers.

marta-devex: +1. For samplekit DX, can we also add a tiny TypeScript compile-time test (tsd) that asserts output shape doesn't widen when a retry happens? Means adding a small .d.ts harness in the e2e job that compiles a consumer expecting the strict shape.

claire-qa: I can add an invariant e2e that: run onboarding with a 401 on first try, then assert final tool output fails validation for an invalid extra field; and run the tsd check to catch widened TS signatures.

ishaan-sdk: I'll open a small PR: 1) thread helper opts (jsonMode, strictSchema, schema, helperType) into RetryWrapper 2) unit tests for retry behavior 3) samplekit e2e + tsd compile check 4) docs blurb in SDK helpers titled "Retry preserves helper instance & typing" 5) an eslint rule in samplekit warning when helperFactory accesses process.env for default strict/json flags.

retry-bot: auth-service: transient 401 burst 2026-05-02T03:12Z — affects <0.5% of calls, primarily unauthenticated flows.

marta-devex: thanks. small ask — include a short dev note in samplekit README showing a safe typed factory pattern:```ts
function makeTypedHelper(opts: HelperOpts) { return new Helper({ jsonMode: true, strictSchema: true, ...opts }); }
// callers: makeTypedHelper(originalOpts) // ensures type + runtime parity on retry
```

ishaan-sdk: will do. plan: PR with fix/tests/docs today, tag @claire-qa for TS test signoff. We'll canary on dedicated after green e2e. :thumbsup:
